title: guarded narrow arithmetic

definition.title: guarded narrow arithmetic
definition.source_excerpt: The H.264-style integer 4×4 inverse-transform model derives a cheap conservative intermediate bound from the maximum absolute dequantized input. For int16 intermediates the largest admitted threshold is 2672; 2672 is admitted and 2673 rejected. Across 120,000 randomized blocks, the guard admitted 57,948. Every admitted block matched the wide-integer reference exactly and zero admitted blocks overflowed. The guard intentionally rejects 38,366 actually-safe blocks, favoring correctness over maximal admission. This validates the admission strategy; it is not yet a SIMD speed benchmark or production decoder kernel.
